New to tidyweave? Follow [Get started](get-started.html) first. These guides
extend that workflow. Choose the task you have now; you do not need to adopt
every integration.

## Prepare and check data

| I want to... | Guide | Adds |
|---|---|---|
| Combine tables without multiplying rows | [Compose products](composing-products.html) | Checked lookups and reusable dependencies |
| Express stricter checks or use pointblank | [Quality rules](quality-gates.html) | Tolerances, reference checks and optional pointblank |
| Diagnose an attempt or inspect earlier data | [Quality and history](quality-history.html) | Saved evidence, release selection and monitoring |
| Correct one of several named deliveries | [Three deliveries and a report](three-deliveries.html) | Payment and reference corrections with retained reports |
| Repeat dependent steps after a correction | [Repeat a workflow](everyday-workflows.html) | A named workflow and selective reruns |

## Store data and report values

| I want to... | Guide | Adds |
|---|---|---|
| Create and reopen an actual local DuckLake | [Create a DuckLake](create-ducklake.html) | DuckLake extension and optional layers |
| Replace a complete month and retain other months | [Monthly reporting case study](getting-started.html) | Partition replacement and dated stock metrics |
| Group calculations or inspect table relationships | [Relationships and metrics](products-metrics.html) | Dimensions, time meaning and optional dm |

## Connect existing tools

| I want to... | Guide | Adds |
|---|---|---|
| Use files, DBI, Parquet, pins, HTTP or targets | [Integrations](optional-integrations.html) | Sources, destinations and their boundaries |
| Run SQL models from R | [Use dbt](dbt-workflows.html) | A separately installed dbt CLI |
| Check received files before building SQL layers | [Build a layered workflow](layered-data-stack.html) | Receipt checks, RAW storage and dbt |
| Work through a larger insurance example | [Insurance reporting](relational-insurance.html) | Three inputs, dm, pointblank, dbt and corrections |

## Understand or extend the package

- [Why tidyweave?](why-tidyweave.html): when the package earns its place.
- [Architecture](workflow-design.html): execution, ownership and adapter boundaries.
- [Write an adapter](extending-tidyweave.html): a runnable extension example.
- [Development record](design-review.html): historical decisions and validation scope.
- [Operations](https://github.com/JanWein/tidyweave/blob/main/docs/OPERATIONS.md): writer coordination and recovery.

Need a definition? Use [Terms](glossary.html). Need a fix? Use
[Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.html). Need an argument? Use the
[function reference](../reference/index.html).
